facts.fact: Larissa 逼宫索舞被拒：他按「惯例」只与现任 Shielder 跳；骂 whore 被他警告（她是王室的脸面）
facts.anchor: “I will be dancing with my Shielder, as I always do.”

facts.fact: 舞池心盾对话：她的隔音盾让两人在喧闹中密谈（「要不要告诉人民」他主秩序）
facts.anchor: She allowed her magic to be seen for only a second before disguising it once more.

facts.fact: 刺杀武器=破魔匕首（可割进盾）——她弃盾改冲击波
facts.anchor: Whatever those blades were, they were capable of cutting into her magic

facts.fact: Walder 战力实演：冰刃穿身、瞬移连斩（一次挥剑斩二人、直穿火者心脏）
facts.anchor: He swung his sword, decapitating them both in one swing.

facts.fact: Fraener 怒态双倍牛大：空中撕人（咬成两半）——双龙协作虐杀刺客
facts.anchor: double the size of an ox, his red scales darker

facts.fact: 她救他：银光入眼即竖盾（半刃穿盾）；反过来 Fraener 救她（pluck 刺客离地）
facts.anchor: A flash of silver caught her attention.
